title: Authentication not accepted by the UE

entities.name: 5G Authentication Challenge
entities.description: Procedure where the UE verifies the 5G core network authenticity using authentication challenge data (RAND, AUTN, ngKSI) received in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network containing 5G authentication challenge data (RAND, AUTN, ngKSI).

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network when authentication challenge is rejected, containing cause value indicating failure reason.

entities.name: RAND
entities.description: Random challenge parameter in authentication challenge data.

entities.name: AUTN
entities.description: Authentication token parameter containing MAC code, sequence number SQN, and AMF field with separation bit.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key set identifier for 5G security context.

entities.name: AUTS
entities.description: Re-synchronization token sent in AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message for synch failure.

entities.name: MAC code failure
entities.description: Condition where MAC code in AUTN parameter is invalid.

entities.name: Non-5G authentication unacceptable
entities.description: Condition where separation bit in AMF field of AUTN is set to 0.

entities.name: ngKSI already in use
entities.description: Condition where ngKSI received in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST is already in use in UE.

entities.name: SQN out of range
entities.description: Condition where sequence number SQN in AUTN parameter is out of range.

entities.name: T3516
entities.description: Timer stopped when UE returns AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.

entities.name: Delete stored RAND and RES*
entities.description: UE behavior to delete any previously stored RAND and RES* when returning AUTHENTICATION FAILURE.

relations.description: Authentication challenge procedure involves receiving AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains RAND parameter.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains AUTN parameter.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains ngKSI parameter.
MAC code failure condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #20.
Non-5G authentication unacceptable condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #26.
ngKSI already in use condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #71.
SQN out of range condition leads to sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #21 and AUTS token.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message contains AUTS token for synch failure case.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message triggers deletion of stored RAND and RES*.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message stops timer T3516 if running.
